body:
Lesson (Fable2, 10-19, w-5405). Never hand an evaluated, gate-credited item to another session, such as a merger, before done. Credited checks are bound to the holder's named root AND its root-naming generation.
- After the handoff, the merger's evaluation judged the merger's root: 0/7, insufficient evidence (e18a6797).
- Handing it back and re-naming the original root moved the generation from 1406 to 1438. Engram then refused a fresh evaluation, because "6287142e ran under root naming generation 1406, not the current naming generation 1438".
- Result: the full gate and live check had to be re-run.
Rule: the producer keeps the claim through the evaluation and done. The merger only commits the byte-identical payload, and the integration owner pushes. Mergers must not request the item's Engram handoff.
